method: Every target page render was reopened in its full-resolution contact sheet; all four P06 correction pages and the rights-blocked German source page were additionally reopened individually at original resolution. Contact sheets themselves were reopened at original resolution.
limitations: Model visual QA checks rendering, layout, legibility, clipping, glyphs, and the identified formula witnesses; it is not native-speaker or human mathematical certification.
